title: One simple setup with reasons

D0.outcome: Explains one simple setup (centre, development, castling) with the reason for each piece's square.

D1.outcome: Plays the setup in model positions and says the reason for each move.

D2.outcome: Plays the setup against varied replies in unlabeled positions, keeping to the reasons, and chooses simple development over a messy pawn grab.

D3.outcome: Adapts the setup when the opponent deviates, without a memorised line, and says which reason still holds.

misconceptions: A setup is a list of moves.
conditions: Beginner or club learner, and an equally good simple option exists.
contrasts: Grabbing a pawn that leads to complicated play when a clear developing move exists.
A one-size setup that ignores an opponent's gambit; answer by freeing moves rather than holding the pawn.
A position far from any known setup.

soft_prereq_notes.POS.CONNECT.D1: the end of the setup is connected rooks
